parties.respondent: The Managing Director, Bangalore Metropolitan, Transport Corporation

summary: Compensation claim under Motor Vehicles Act; contributory negligence; High Court's 25% attribution to deceased reversed for lack of evidence; Tribunal's finding of sole negligence of bus driver upheld; income assessment: Tribunal's Rs.62,725/month affirmed over High Court's Rs.50,000; preponderance of probability standard applied; compensation recalculated to Rs.1,20,84,925 with 9% interest; impugned judgment modified.
legal_provisions_cited: Kumari Kiran v. Sajjan Singh and Ors., (2015) 1 SCC 339
Rajwati alias Rajjo v. United India Insurance Company Ltd. & Ors., 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1699
final_judgment: Civil Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; compensation enhanced to Rs.1,20,84,925 with interest at 9% as per Tribunal.
